criterion_fired: Competition component scoring and state management criteria (1-5)
suggested_change: Separate 'analysis quality' (did agent identify Oda is existing customer?) from 'scoring format' (must use N/A vs Unknown). Current rubric conflates these. Recommend: (1) Agent must identify deal type (new/renewal/expansion); (2) Competition scoring: 0/10 if unknown, N/A if confirmed existing, 1-10 if new. (3) Remove requirement for explicit 'maintaining score' language—carry-forward is implicit when no contradictory data exists.
